items.sentence: The FY2023 step came from the Cerner acquisition, which added $5.9 billion of revenue, 11.8% of the year's total .

passages.filing: FY2023 10-K Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis
passages.text: Excluding the effects of foreign currency rate fluctuations, our total revenues increased across our three businesses during fiscal 2023 relative to fiscal 2022 primarily due to revenue contributions from our acquisition of Cerner. Excluding the impact of our acquisition of Cerner, the constant currency revenues increase during fiscal 2023 relative to fiscal 2022 in our cloud and license business was attributable to growth in our cloud services and license support revenues as customers purchased our applications and infrastructure technologies via cloud and license deployment models and also renewed their related cloud contracts and license support contracts to continue to gain access to the latest versions of our technologies and to receive support services, partially offset by a decrease in our cloud license and on-premise license revenues. In our hardware business, the increase during fiscal 2023 was primarily due to growth in our Oracle Exadata and certain other strategic hardware product offerings.

items.sentence: FY2026's step was cloud-led: cloud and software revenue rose $9.3 billion as customers bought applications and infrastructure and renewed cloud contracts .

passages.text: Our cloud and software business’ total revenues increased by $9.3 billion in reported currency in fiscal 2026 relative to fiscal 2025 primarily due to an increase in cloud revenues as customers purchased our applications and infrastructure technologies and renewed their related cloud contracts. passages.text: Total GAAP operating expenses increased by $7.0 billion in reported currency in fiscal 2026 relative to fiscal 2025. items.sentence: The largest move was FY2022, when operating margin fell 11.8pp on litigation charges recorded to acquisition related and other expenses .

passages.filing: FY2022 10-K Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis
passages.text: Excluding the effects of foreign currency rate fluctuations, our total operating expenses increased during fiscal 2022 relative to fiscal 2021 substantially due to certain litigation related charges recorded to acquisition related and other expenses as further described in Note 16 of Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report. In addition, our total operating expenses increased due to higher cloud services and license support expenses, which were primarily due to higher employee related expenses and infrastructure investments that were made to support the increase in our cloud and license business’ revenues; higher services expenses, which increased primarily due to higher employee related and external contractor expenses; and higher research and development and general and administrative expenses, both of which increased primarily due to higher employee related expenses.
